Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

Revision in the rates of DA, HRA or other allowances either in the parent or borrowing organization shall not be an occasion for fresh option.  
If the pay in cadre post undergoes downward revision, deputation pay  
is also liable to be refixed.  
- (h) Within the same station In other cases
- Rates of Deputation (Duty) Allowance with effect from 1-7-2017. - 5% of Basic Pay subject to maximum of < 4,500 p.m. -10% of Basic Pay subject to maximum of < 9,000 p.m.
